packs.title: 11e core ability and weapon keyword summaries
packs.source: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules, with current rules appendix cross-check
packs.coverage: Short summaries of commonly used core abilities and weapon traits. Consult the Core Rules and Rules Appendix for combinations and exceptions.

entries.name: Anti
entries.text: Against the matching target keyword, an unmodified wound roll meeting the weapon’s listed threshold counts as a critical wound.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.03

entries.name: Assault
entries.text: An unengaged unit that Advanced may shoot with its Assault weapons.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.04, 10.05

entries.name: Blast
entries.text: Gain one attack die per full group of five models in the unit when it was targeted. For Blast X, gain X dice per five models.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.05

entries.name: Cleave
entries.text: If all the weapon’s attacks were assigned to one unit, add X attack dice for each full group of five models it had when targeted.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.06

entries.name: Close-Quarters
entries.text: In close-quarters shooting, non-Monster and non-Vehicle models can fire these weapons at enemies engaging the unit. In other shooting, those models choose either their Close-Quarters weapons or their other ranged weapons.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.07, 10.06

entries.name: Deadly Demise
entries.text: After the destroyed model’s passengers finish emergency disembarking, roll a D6. On a 6, every unit within 6″ takes the listed mortal wounds. Roll variable damage separately for each unit.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.08

entries.name: Deep Strike
entries.text: If every model in the unit has Deep Strike, its ingress can place it anywhere more than 8″ horizontally from all enemy units, including in the enemy deployment zone.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.09

entries.name: Devastating Wounds
entries.text: On a critical wound, end that attack sequence and inflict mortal wounds equal to the weapon’s Damage after resolving normal damage. Each critical wound can damage only one model this way.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.10

entries.name: Extra Attacks
entries.text: When this model fights, select all of its Extra Attacks weapons plus one other melee weapon if available.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.11

entries.name: Feel No Pain
entries.text: Each time the model would lose a wound, roll a D6. Prevent the loss if the roll meets the number shown in the ability.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.12

entries.name: Fights First
entries.text: When every model has this ability, the unit fights in the Fights First part of the Fight phase.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.13

entries.name: Firing Deck
entries.text: When your Transport is selected to shoot, choose up to X embarked models from units that have not shot this phase. Their eligible ranged weapons can shoot as the Transport’s weapons, one per model. Units still embarked become ineligible to shoot for the turn. One Shot weapons are excluded.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.14

entries.name: Hazardous
entries.text: After the unit’s attacks resolve, make one hazard roll for each Hazardous weapon selected to shoot or fight.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.15

entries.name: Heavy
entries.text: Add 1 to hit in your Shooting phase if the unit is unengaged, did not enter the battlefield this turn, and every model moved at most 3″ this turn.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.16

entries.name: Hover
entries.text: A unit with Hover keeps the full maximum movement distance when it takes to the skies.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.17

entries.name: Ignores Cover
entries.text: The target receives no benefit of cover against attacks from this weapon, even if an ability would provide cover.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.18

entries.name: Indirect Fire
entries.text: Allows the unit to use indirect shooting. Check the indirect shooting rules for restrictions and penalties when firing without visibility.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.19, 10.07

entries.name: Infiltrators
entries.text: If every model has Infiltrators, the unit can deploy more than 8″ horizontally from the enemy deployment zone and all enemy units.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.20

entries.name: Lance
entries.text: Add 1 to wound if the attacker’s unit made a charge move this turn.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.21

entries.name: Leader
entries.text: An eligible Leader can join one of its listed bodyguard units during battle formations.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.22, 19

entries.name: Lethal Hits
entries.text: On a critical hit you may skip the wound roll and automatically wound. Doing so cannot trigger effects tied to a critical wound.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.23

entries.name: Lone Operative
entries.text: A standalone Lone Operative is invisible to enemies outside 12″, or the range stated in the ability. Indirect Fire also cannot target it from outside that range. Check attached-unit exceptions in the appendix.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.24

entries.name: Melta
entries.text: Add X Damage if the target was within half the weapon’s range when you selected targets.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.25

entries.name: One Shot
entries.text: Each weapon can be selected once per battle. Returning a destroyed bearer to its unit does not reset an already-used weapon.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.26

entries.name: Pistol
entries.text: Use the same rules as Close-Quarters. Pistol is the older label.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.27

entries.name: Precision
entries.text: At Allocation Order, choose a group containing a Character visible to at least one attacker. That group receives the weapon’s attacks until destroyed or the attacks finish.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.28

entries.name: Psychic
entries.text: You can ignore any skill and hit-roll modifiers for attacks with this weapon. Other abilities can check whether an attack is Psychic.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.29

entries.name: Rapid Fire
entries.text: Add X attack dice when the target was within half the weapon’s range as you selected targets.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.30

entries.name: Scouts
entries.text: If every model has Scouts, the unit can take its listed pre-battle move from its deployment zone or deploy wholly in that zone from Strategic Reserves. An eligible Dedicated Transport can take the move instead. The move ends more than 8″ horizontally from each enemy.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.31–32

entries.name: Stealth
entries.text: The entire unit gains the benefit of cover against ranged attacks when every model has this ability.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.33

entries.name: Support
entries.text: A Support unit can join a listed bodyguard during battle formations. A bodyguard can include a Leader and a Support where the attachment rules allow both.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.34, 19

entries.name: Super-Heavy Walker
entries.text: When moving normally, Advancing or Falling Back, the unit can cross non-Titanic models and terrain sections up to 4″ tall. It can take Mobile for that move and then risks battle-shock on a roll of 1.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.35

entries.name: Sustained Hits
entries.text: Each critical hit generates the listed number of extra hits on the target.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.36

entries.name: Torrent
entries.text: The weapon’s attacks automatically hit. The rules appendix excludes pairing Torrent with Indirect Fire or Precision.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.37

entries.name: Twin-Linked
entries.text: You may reroll the weapon’s wound rolls.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules § 24.38

entries.name: Damaged
entries.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls once the model has its listed remaining wounds or fewer.
references: Wahapedia 11e Core Rules § 24.39

packs.title: Leagues of Votann reference summaries
packs.source: Games Workshop Leagues of Votann Faction Pack v1.2 and 11e Core Rules
packs.coverage: Partial coverage: Berehk Stornbröw, the five detachments published in the Faction Pack, the faction rule and selected datasheet updates. Consult the current Codex and official updates for the remaining datasheets and detachments.

sources.label: Games Workshop Leagues of Votann Faction Pack v1.2
Games Workshop Codex preview of Prioritised Efficiency

entries.name: Prioritised Efficiency
entries.text: Start in Hostile Acquisition. At the end of your Command phase, after accounting for Yield Points (YP), use Hostile Acquisition below 7 YP or Fortify Takeover at 7 YP or more. That choice holds until your next Command phase. At the end of either player’s Command phase, gain 1 YP for controlling a home objective. From round 2, also gain 1 each for controlling at least one objective outside your deployment zone, controlling at least two outside it, and controlling more objectives overall than your opponent.
references: Games Workshop Codex preview: Maximise your yields
Wahapedia 11e: Leagues of Votann army rules

entries.name: Hostile Acquisition
entries.text: Reroll Advance and Charge rolls. Attacks get +1 to hit when the enemy unit is in range of an objective.
references: Games Workshop Codex preview: Maximise your yields
Wahapedia 11e: Leagues of Votann army rules

entries.name: Fortify Takeover
entries.text: An attacking unit gets +1 to hit from within range of an objective your army controls. When an incoming attack’s Strength beats a friendly non-Vehicle unit’s Toughness, that attack takes −1 to wound.
references: Games Workshop Codex preview: Maximise your yields
Wahapedia 11e: Leagues of Votann army rules

entries.name: Berehk Stornbröw
entries.text: One Epic Hero equipped with Kromlôk’s Revenge and Warforge Gauntlets. Kromlôk’s Revenge is a single weapon with two profiles. Choose its profile before selecting targets. Berehk can lead Cthonian Beserks.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, pp. 9–10
Wahapedia 11e: Berehk Stornbröw

entries.name: Kromlôk’s Revenge – graviton strikes
entries.text: Select this profile when using the heavy strikes, especially against Monsters or Vehicles.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, pp. 9–10

entries.name: Kromlôk’s Revenge – plasma sweeps
entries.text: This profile makes more attacks at lower Strength and Damage than graviton strikes.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, pp. 9–10

entries.name: Warforge Gauntlets
entries.text: Resolve these extra attacks in addition to the weapon chosen to fight with.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, pp. 9–10

entries.name: Break the Foe
entries.text: Give the unit’s melee weapons Sustained Hits 1, so a critical hit generates one additional hit.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, pp. 9–10

entries.name: Relentless Avalanche
entries.text: Berehk’s unit can use Heroic Intervention at a 1 CP discount. Its use is independent of the stratagem’s use on other units in that phase, in either order.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, pp. 9–10

entries.name: Feel No Pain 4+
entries.text: Roll once per wound the model would lose. Ignore that wound on a 4 or higher.
references: Games Workshop 11e Core Rules: Feel No Pain

entries.name: Sagitaur Spearhead
entries.text: Your Sagitaurs gain a 6″ Scouts move.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 2

entries.name: Saturation Rounds (Upgrade)
entries.text: Eligible Sagitaur units gain Ignores Cover on their ranged attacks.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 2

entries.name: Optimised Attack Lines (Upgrade)
entries.text: Gives a Sagitaur the Mobile keyword.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 2

entries.name: Coordinated Crossfire
entries.text: At the start of your Shooting phase, spend 1 CP to pick up to two of your Sagitaurs and one enemy unit. When those Sagitaurs shoot that target, they can reroll hit and wound rolls of 1.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 2

entries.name: Outflanking Armour
entries.text: From round 2, at the end of the opposing Movement phase, spend 1 CP to bring in up to two Sagitaurs from Strategic Reserves with an ingress move each.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 2

entries.name: Built to Last
entries.text: Spend 1 CP when a Sagitaur is targeted in the enemy Shooting phase. Ranged attacks targeting it take −1 to wound if their Strength exceeds its Toughness.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 2

entries.name: Eye of the Hunt
entries.text: Hernkyn units shoot with +1 to hit at targets within 12″.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 3

entries.name: Pan-spectral Lockons (Upgrade)
entries.text: A Hernkyn Pioneers unit can spot a visible enemy within 12″ in your Shooting phase. Spotting adds 3″ to that enemy unit’s detection range.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 3

entries.name: Shroudwërke Talismans (Upgrade)
entries.text: Reduce the upgraded Hernkyn Yaegirs unit’s detection range by 3″.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 3

entries.name: Scornful Analysis
entries.text: Spend 1 CP at the start of your Shooting phase. Choose one Hernkyn unit and a visible enemy within 12″ of it. Your Leagues of Votann units’ attacks gain Ignores Cover against that enemy.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 3

entries.name: No Shot Wasted
entries.text: Spend 1 CP when selecting a Hernkyn unit to shoot. Its ranged attacks gain Lethal Hits.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 3

entries.name: Economy of Motion
entries.text: In the opposing Movement phase, spend 1 CP after an enemy ends a move within 8″ of unengaged Hernkyn Pioneers. Those Pioneers can make a Normal move of up to D3+3″.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 3

entries.name: Avatars of the Ancestors
entries.text: Kâhl, Einhyr Champion, Einhyr Hearthguard and Ûthar the Destined units reroll ranged wound rolls of 1 against targets within 9″. The unique tag prevents taking this alongside Hearthband.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 4

entries.name: High Kâhl
entries.text: If a model in the bearer’s unit dies in the Fight phase before the unit has been selected to fight, roll a D6. On a 4+, leave it in place until the unit finishes fighting or the phase ends, whichever is first.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 4

entries.name: Ironskein
entries.text: The Kâhl gains 2 Wounds.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 4

entries.name: Brëkkeknots
entries.text: Spend 1 CP when an enemy targets your Einhyr Hearthguard in the opposing Shooting phase or a Fight phase. The Hearthguard get a 4+ invulnerable save.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 4

entries.name: Fury of the Hearth
entries.text: Spend 1 CP when selecting Einhyr Hearthguard to shoot. Their ranged attacks gain 1 Strength. Spend 1 YP to also give them Sustained Hits 1.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 4

entries.name: Materialisation Matrices
entries.text: Spend 1 CP when Einhyr Hearthguard with Deep Strike make an ingress move in your Movement phase. They can arrive anywhere more than 6″ horizontally from every enemy, including the enemy deployment zone. They give up charging for the rest of the turn.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 4

entries.name: Methodical Annihilation
entries.text: When a friendly Votann model attacks its weapon’s nearest legal target or an enemy engaging its unit, reroll wound rolls of 1. Improve AP by 1 as well if the attacking unit is a Kâhl, Einhyr Hearthguard or Ûthar the Destined unit.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 5

entries.name: Bastion Shield
entries.text: Worsen incoming ranged AP by 1 when the attacker is within 12″ of the bearer’s unit. Spending 1 YP extends this protection to 18″ through the end of the phase.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 5

entries.name: Quake Multigenerator
entries.text: After this Kâhl shoots, choose one non-Titanic enemy unit hit by the bearer. Its attacks take −1 to hit until your next turn begins.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 5

entries.name: Ironskein
entries.text: Add 2 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 5

entries.name: High Kâhl
entries.text: When an enemy melee attack kills a model from the bearer’s unit that is yet to fight this phase, roll a D6. On 4+, the slain model fights immediately after the attacker finishes resolving attacks and is removed afterwards.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 5

entries.name: Brëkkeknots
entries.text: Spend 1 CP when the enemy selects a friendly Kâhl, Ûthar the Destined or Einhyr Hearthguard unit as a target in the opposing Shooting phase or either Fight phase. The targeted unit gets a 4+ invulnerable save for that phase.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 6

entries.name: Sure of Purpose
entries.text: Spend 1 CP in the Fight phase for a friendly Votann unit that has yet to be selected to fight. It can move its models up to 6″ on Pile-in and Consolidation moves that phase.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 6

entries.name: Superior Craftsmanship
entries.text: Spend 2 CP in the Fight phase on a friendly Votann unit yet to be selected to fight. It deals +1 Damage on attacks against Monsters and Vehicles that phase.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 6

entries.name: Unyielding Aggression
entries.text: Spend 1 CP after your Votann Infantry unit Falls Back in your Movement phase. It can still shoot and charge this turn.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 6

entries.name: Materialisation Matrices
entries.text: Spend 1 CP in your Reinforcements step for a Votann unit using Deep Strike from Reserves. Keep it more than 6″ horizontally from all enemy units when placing it. The unit gives up charging that turn.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 6

entries.name: Fury of the Hearth
entries.text: Spend 1 CP on Einhyr Hearthguard yet to be selected to shoot in your Shooting phase. Their ranged weapons gain 1 Strength for the phase. Spend 1 YP for Sustained Hits 1 on those weapons too.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 6

entries.name: Ruthless Reinvestment
entries.text: Start in Hostile Acquisition. This detachment replaces the automatic switch at 7 YP. You may spend 3 YP at the end of your Command phase to toggle your army between Hostile Acquisition and Fortify Takeover.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 7

entries.name: Mercenary Prospector
entries.text: Gain 2 YP each time the bearer’s unit kills an enemy unit.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 7

entries.name: Metaphysical Brokerage
entries.text: If the bearer is on the battlefield at the end of your turn, top up the YP earned that turn to 3 if you gained fewer.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 7

entries.name: Etacarn SB9 Targeting Implant
entries.text: The bearer’s unit rerolls hit rolls of 1. When selecting the unit to shoot or fight, spend 3 YP to add Sustained Hits 1 to its attacks for that phase.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 7

entries.name: Asset Manipulator
entries.text: At the start of your Command phase, spend 3 YP to give enemy models in units within 3″ of the bearer −1 Objective Control for the rest of the turn.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 7

entries.name: Auxiliary Contract
entries.text: Spend 1 CP in your Shooting phase or a Fight phase on a Votann Infantry or Mounted unit that has yet to be selected to shoot or fight in that phase. Its weapons gain Precision for the phase.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 8

entries.name: Optimal Expenditure
entries.text: Spend 1 CP in the Fight phase on Votann Infantry yet to be selected to fight. Its attacks reroll hits and wounds of 1 for the phase. An extra 3 YP lets you reroll any wound roll while still rerolling only hits of 1.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 8

entries.name: Grand Artifice
entries.text: Spend 1 CP after a Votann unit Falls Back in your Movement phase. It can still shoot and charge this turn.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 8

entries.name: Privateer Arsenal
entries.text: Spend 1 CP in your Shooting phase on Votann Infantry yet to be selected to shoot. It rerolls hit and wound rolls of 1 for the phase. An extra 3 YP lets you reroll any hit roll while still rerolling only wounds of 1.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 8

entries.name: New Horizons
entries.text: At the end of the enemy Fight phase, spend 1 CP to embark unengaged Votann Infantry wholly within 6″ of an eligible friendly Transport.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 8

entries.name: Mobile Exploitation
entries.text: At the end of the enemy Fight phase, spend 1 CP to move one unengaged Hernkyn unit into Strategic Reserves. Spend an additional 2 YP to pick up to two eligible units instead.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 8

entries.name: Unhinged Vengeance
entries.text: After an enemy unit shoots in the opponent’s Shooting phase, Buri’s unit can make a surge move of up to D6+2″ if those attacks cost Buri a wound.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 11
Wahapedia 11e: unit entry or faction FAQ

entries.name: Transport capacity
entries.text: Carries 14 Leagues of Votann Infantry. Exoarmour, Exoframe and Ironkin Steeljacks use two spaces per model. Artillery cannot embark. The Fortress has the Frame keyword.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 11
Wahapedia 11e: unit entry or faction FAQ

entries.name: Pragmatic Hunters
entries.text: If an enemy ends a move within 8″ in the opposing Movement phase, unengaged Yaegirs can make a Normal move up to D6″.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 11
Wahapedia 11e: unit entry or faction FAQ

entries.name: Predictive Guidance
entries.text: Once per round, discount a Fire Overwatch or Heroic Intervention stratagem targeting this unit by 1 CP.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 11
Wahapedia 11e: unit entry or faction FAQ

entries.name: Transport capacity
entries.text: Carries six Leagues of Votann Infantry. Artillery, Exoarmour, Exoframe and Ironkin Steeljacks cannot embark. The Sagitaur has the Frame keyword.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 11
Wahapedia 11e: unit entry or faction FAQ

entries.name: Ancestral Fortune
entries.text: Once per turn, spend 1 YP to treat one of Ûthar’s hit rolls, wound rolls or saving throws as an unmodified 6.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 11
Wahapedia 11e: unit entry or faction FAQ

entries.name: Science Guild Support FAQ
entries.text: Another Arkanyst Evaluator on its own within 3″ cannot grant this model Lone Operative.
references: Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 11
Wahapedia 11e: unit entry or faction FAQ

entries.name: Hearthband
entries.text: This detachment is in the Hearthband unique group and cannot be selected with Hearthguard Covenant.
references: Official Munitorum Field Manual v1.6, Leagues of Votann detachments
Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 5

entries.name: Hearthguard Covenant
entries.text: This detachment is in the Hearthband unique group and cannot be selected with Hearthband.
references: Official Munitorum Field Manual v1.6, Leagues of Votann detachments
Games Workshop Faction Pack v1.2, p. 4
